strength_rule: Laplace (for+1)/(for+against+2). obs<3 => weak/untested; obs>=5 and strength<0.4 => forgotten; else active if strength>=0.4 else weak. Lessons never become trading rules automatically.

lessons.text: XM par 1 ghante ke chhote trades ka spread, slippage aur overnight fee edge kha jaata hai. Bina cost ke backtest jhootha lagta hai.
sources: v1 3m: no-cost -43.11 / expectancy -1.87; with 0.05%/side costs -74.36 / -3.23 (costs 31.25 over 23 trades)
lessons.notes: 4 backtests (3 strategies + v1). None stayed solidly profitable after estimated XM costs. This is a standing lesson, not updated from a single paper P/L.

lessons.text: UP-trend ke baad der se liye gaye BUY (price 4H EMA50 se 5 ATR se zyada upar) aksar haar te hain. Topping market mein late long mat lo.
sources: v1 losing trades #1,#2,#3,#4,#10 (25 Aug–23 Sep 2026): longs 5.7–7.9 ATR above 4H EMA50, all stopped out
lessons.notes: Only the 5 documented stretched v1 longs were counted. Advanced trades were not tagged for extension, so this sample is still small.

lessons.text: Kamzor / doji trigger candle (body range ka 20% se kam) par entry aksar fail hui. Conviction kam ho to skip.
sources: v1 losing trades #2,#4,#5,#6,#12,#15: body about 0.10–0.19 of the range
lessons.notes: Winning doji entries were not systematically counted in v1, so evidence_against may be understated. Treat as provisional until paper/backtest tags both sides.

lessons.text: Sideways regime mein 1H setups, cost ke baad, net ghaate mein rahe. Level bounce kaafi nahi jab trend saaf na ho — NO TRADE normal hai.
sources: advanced S1 sideways: 53 trades, 13 wins, net -237.56 USDT, -0.45R, PF 0.50
advanced S2 sideways: 23 trades, 5 wins, net -126.66, -0.55R, PF 0.43
advanced S3 sideways: 21 trades, 8 wins, net -30.39, -0.14R, PF 0.80
lessons.notes: Combined 103 trades, 28 wins, 75 losses. Mixed strategies on the same 12-month (and 3-month v1) window.

lessons.text: 1,000 USDT account par XM ka sabse chhota lot 0.01 hai. Stop lagbhag $1,000 se door ho (1% risk par) to setup le nahi sakte — skip. Ye mechanical limit hai, strategy ka fayda nahi.
sources: advanced Phase 6 risk engine, 1% risk, 0.01 lot step: S1 skipped 155, S2 skipped 46, S3 skipped 115 (plus 47 S1 pauses from the 3-loss rule)
lessons.notes: evidence_for is the count of setups that could not be sized at 1% on 1,000 USDT. Trades that were taken with a legal size are not counted as against.

lessons.text: High-volatility / news window (CPI, NFP, FOMC ke ±2h, ya ATR p90, ya volume 3x) mein 1H strategies cost ke baad ghaate mein rahi.
sources: advanced S1 HV/News: 53 trades, 16 wins, net -111.90, -0.21R, PF 0.73
advanced S2 HV/News: 33 trades, 12 wins, net -21.61, -0.07R, PF 0.91
advanced S3 HV/News: 86 trades, 29 wins, net -172.81, -0.20R, PF 0.74
lessons.notes: 172 trades, 57 wins, 115 losses. This regime mixes news, wide ATR, and volume spikes.

lessons.text: Jo combination training window mein acchi lage, test window mein aksar fail ho jaati hai. Walk-forward ke bagair rule mat apnao (overfit).
sources: advanced Phase 4: 3 strategies x 3 windows = 9 test windows; 8 failed. Only S2 window C passed, and that was 6 test trades (+0.23R, PF 1.37).
lessons.notes: Standing process lesson. Not updated from a single paper trade.

lessons.text: Teeno 12-mahine strategies aur v1 3-mahine test, cost ke baad, live pass criteria fail. Chhote paper jeet (jaise 4 trade, +26 USDT, bina XM cost) ko edge mat samjho.
lessons.notes: 4 failed official backtests vs the live pass bar (positive expectancy, PF>=1.3, DD<10%, walk-forward hold). Paper wins are not counted as against because they are a tiny, cost-free sample.
